categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Baosi Energy Equipment Co., Ltd. primarily operates in four main business segments: screw compressors, vacuum pumps, hydraulic pumps, and high-efficiency precision cutting tools. The company focuses on the research, design, production, and sales of high-end precision mechanical components and complete sets of equipment, serving various industrial sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including German-imported KAPP grinding machines for rotor processing, 6S-based manufacturing management systems, and continuous R&D investment in energy-efficient and environmentally friendly products. Production methods combine stock production for standard parts and order-based production for customized components, ensuring flexibility and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are industrial enterprises in sectors such as mechanical manufacturing, petrochemicals, textiles, food processing, pharmaceuticals, electronics, power generation, metallurgy, and emerging industries like photovoltaics, lithium batteries, and semiconductors. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a strong presence in East China and expanding overseas sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with significant sales concentrated in East China, South China, North China, Central China, Northwest China, Northeast China, and Southwest China regions. It also has overseas operations and exports, with subsidiaries and investments in Shanghai, Chongqing, Suzhou, and the United States.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ningbo Baosi Energy Equipment operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing and assembly of precision mechanical components and complete equipment sets such as compressors, pumps, and cutting tools. It engages in direct sales to industrial customers and distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in energy-saving and environmentally friendly technologies, aiming for import substitution and high-quality manufacturing. R&D priorities include developing advanced screw compressors, vacuum pumps tailored for emerging industries, hydraulic pumps with servo energy-saving systems, and expanding product lines with digital and intelligent manufacturing capabilities. It also focuses on expanding international markets and enhancing production capacity through new bases.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of compressors, vacuum pumps, hydraulic pumps, and cutting tools. The company uses a combination of direct sales and distributor sales channels, with direct sales accounting for the majority. It also earns investment income from equity disposals and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer in the screw compressor and fluid machinery industry, recognized for its advanced technology and product quality, including national manufacturing champion products. It faces competition from both international brands and domestic enterprises, with increasing competitiveness due to technological improvements and market expansion.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.32 billion, a slight decrease of 3.9% from the previous year, while net profit attributable to shareholders surged by 196.58% to RMB 832 million. Total assets stood at RMB 3.54 billion with net assets of RMB 2.5 billion, reflecting a solid growth trajectory supported by strategic divestments and operational improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ningbo Baosi Energy Equipment emphasizes energy efficiency, environmental protection, and import substitution as core product values. Its products feature high precision, reliability, and advanced manufacturing processes, supported by strong R&D and quality control systems. The company offers customized solutions and comprehensive after-sales services, aiming to be a leading global brand in vacuum pumps and fluid machinery.
